name: 微信文章捕手
tagline: Saves a WeChat article as clean Markdown and JSON, images and metadata intact
description: Send it a link to a WeChat official-account article and it returns the full piece as tidy Markdown and JSON: headline, outlet, publish time, body text, and images all carried through. On its first run it builds the fetching environment it needs, and other bots can call on it as their extraction layer.
author: cgnot996
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
